Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting farming services from business and occupation tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting farming services from business andoccupation tax; amending RCW 82.04.330; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.04.330 and 2001 c 118 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter shall not apply to any: (1) Farmer that sells anyagricultural product at wholesale ((or to any)); (2) farmer who grows,raises, or produces agricultural products owned by others, such ascustom feed operations; or (3) services provided by a person to afarmer in the growing, raising, or producing, upon lands in which thefarmer has a present right of possession, of any agricultural productto be sold. This exemption shall not apply to any person selling suchproducts at retail or to any person selling manufactured substances orarticles. This chapter shall also not apply to any persons who participate inthe federal conservation reserve program or its successor administeredby the United States department of agriculture with respect to land p. 1 SB 6542enrolled in that program.
